tasks.subject: Task 1: agent_proxy module (HTTP + WebSocket)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A self-contained proxy that forwards /folio/agent/terminal/** to ttyd for both HTTP and WebSocket, injecting X-Folio-Agent-Authenticated and enforcing the folio_agent_session cookie.

**Files:**
- Create: folio_backend/agent_proxy.py
- Create: tests/test_agent_proxy.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- authed HTTP forwarded to origin with X-Folio-Agent-Authenticated: yes; status/body relayed
- unauthed HTTP -> 401 with no upstream call
- authed WebSocket bridges messages both ways; upstream handshake carried the auth header
- unauthed WebSocket closed (1008), no upstream connection

**Verify:** nix-shell -p 'python3.withPackages(ps: with ps; [ fastapi uvicorn pydantic httpx werkzeug python-multipart starlette ebooklib beautifulsoup4 websockets ])' --run 'python -m unittest tests.test_agent_proxy -v' -> OK (4 tests)

**Steps:** TDD — write tests/test_agent_proxy.py (fake threaded HTTP + websockets echo upstreams, FakeAuth); confirm fail on missing module; implement agent_proxy.py register_agent_terminal_proxy(app, auth, origin) with @app.websocket and @app.api_route for TERMINAL_PREFIX + '/{path:path}', cookie auth via agent_router.COOKIE, header injection, _bridge() pumping both ways; confirm pass; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["folio_backend/agent_proxy.py", "tests/test_agent_proxy.py"], "verifyCommand": "nix-shell -p 'python3.withPackages(ps: with ps; [ fastapi uvicorn pydantic httpx werkzeug python-multipart starlette ebooklib beautifulsoup4 websockets ])' --run 'python -m unittest tests.test_agent_proxy -v'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["authed HTTP forwarded with auth header", "unauthed HTTP 401 no upstream", "authed WS bridges both ways + header on handshake", "unauthed WS closed 1008 no upstream"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wire proxy into create_app before static mount + add dep
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Register the terminal proxy in create_app ahead of the /folio static mount when companion is enabled and FOLIO_AGENT_TERMINAL_ORIGIN is set; add websockets to deps.

**Files:**
- Modify: folio_backend/app.py (static/companion region ~246-273)
- Modify: folio_backend/setup.py (add websockets)
- Create: tests/test_app_terminal_proxy.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- with companion env + static dir + FOLIO_AGENT_TERMINAL_ORIGIN, GET /folio/agent/terminal/x (no cookie) -> 401 (proxy), not 404/static
- a normal /folio static path still served by StaticFiles
- websockets in setup.py install_requires
- full existing suite still passes

**Verify:** nix-shell -p 'python3.withPackages(ps: with ps; [ fastapi uvicorn pydantic httpx werkzeug python-multipart starlette ebooklib beautifulsoup4 websockets ])' --run 'python -m unittest tests.test_app_terminal_proxy -v && python -m unittest discover -s tests' -> OK

**Steps:** TDD — write tests/test_app_terminal_proxy.py (temp secrets json via werkzeug generate_password_hash, temp static dir with index.html, companion env incl FOLIO_AGENT_TERMINAL_ORIGIN); confirm fail (404 not 401); restructure app.py to compute companion config + AgentAuth once, register proxy BEFORE the /folio mount, then mount static, then include agent router reusing the auth; add websockets to setup.py; confirm pass + full suite; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["folio_backend/app.py", "folio_backend/setup.py", "tests/test_app_terminal_proxy.py"], "verifyCommand": "nix-shell -p 'python3.withPackages(ps: with ps; [ fastapi uvicorn pydantic httpx werkzeug python-multipart starlette ebooklib beautifulsoup4 websockets ])' --run 'python -m unittest discover -s tests'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["proxy precedes static mount (401 not 404 without cookie)", "static still served", "websockets in setup.py", "no regressions"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: anixpkgs wiring (dependency + service env)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make the deployed backend depend on websockets and know ttyd's origin.

**Files:**
- Modify: anixpkgs/pkgs/python-packages/folio-backend/default.nix (add websockets input + propagatedBuildInputs)
- Modify: anixpkgs/pkgs/modules/folio/module.nix (add FOLIO_AGENT_TERMINAL_ORIGIN env in the companion optionals list)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- folio-backend package builds with websockets (checkPhase runs the new tests)
- folio-backend service sets FOLIO_AGENT_TERMINAL_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:<agentTerminal> when companion enabled

**Verify:** nix build .#folio-backend (from anixpkgs flake dir) succeeds and checkPhase passes.

**Steps:** add websockets to folio-backend/default.nix inputs + propagatedBuildInputs; add the FOLIO_AGENT_TERMINAL_ORIGIN line to module.nix companion env list using service-ports.folio.agentTerminal; nix build .#folio-backend; commit in anixpkgs. See workspace-development + anixpkgs-deploy workflows.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["anixpkgs/pkgs/python-packages/folio-backend/default.nix", "anixpkgs/pkgs/modules/folio/module.nix"], "verifyCommand": "nix build .#folio-backend", "acceptanceCriteria": ["package builds with websockets; checkPhase passes", "service sets FOLIO_AGENT_TERMINAL_ORIGIN when companion enabled"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Deploy and verify end-to-end [user-gate]
tasks.description:
**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Goal:** Deploy the change to the live machine and confirm the desktop agent terminal renders.

**Files:** none (deploy + verification).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- after rebuild, http://127.0.0.1:6868/folio/agent/terminal/ WITHOUT a session cookie returns 401 (proxy present) instead of 404 (pre-fix)
- with a valid session cookie it returns ttyd HTML (200)
- in the Electron desktop app: open folio -> agent panel -> pick an agent -> terminal renders (no black panel) and is interactive

**Verify:** probe shows 401 (no cookie) / 200 (with cookie); plus the manual desktop check.

**Steps:** ensure folio changes committed/pushed and anixpkgs input updated (workspace-development); deploy via anixpkgs-deploy (NixOS rebuild), restart folio-backend.service if needed; probe 127.0.0.1:6868/folio/agent/terminal/ expecting 401 (was 404); launch folio-desktop, pick an agent, confirm the terminal renders and accepts input; capture outcome.
